content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Christian Devotion's PostChristian DevotionMarch 10 at 12:00 AM · Shared with PublicAction star Chuck Norris reflects on his faith journey, crediting his mother for keeping him close to God and admitting to periods of drifting from faith. He emphasizes, “the Lord never drifted from me. He stayed with me the whole time. Amen.” Norris shares how seeing his wife read the Bible inspired him to reconnect with daily Scripture.
